meta.status: DRAFT - machine-extracted from the map scans; must be reviewed. See docs/map-data.md
meta.hex_id: Sheet letter + CCRR as printed on the map (e.g. C4321 = Bardia).
meta.layout: Flat-topped hexes in columns (as scanned). Odd columns sit half a hex towards lower row numbers.
meta.global_coords: gcol = printed column (higher = further north); grow = 33*sheetIndex + printed row (higher = further east). Row 01 of a sheet is the same hex as row 34 of the previous sheet.
meta.partial_hex_rule: Decision D5: any land makes a land hex; a non-clear terrain covering >= 1/4 of the land beats clear, largest share wins, costlier breaks ties. needsReview marks near-threshold and texture calls.

hexside_values.escarpment: thick escarpment hexside (up/down side NOT yet determined)
hexside_values.wire_candidate: blue dashed line on Maps C/D - the Libya/Egypt frontier wire
hexside_values.blue_line: other blue hexside line - river, canal or wadi; classify by hand

not_extracted: villages/birs, oases, airfields, ports, major cities (see locations.json)
